approach_summary_max_100_words: We cleaned duplicates and imputed missing values, then flagged abnormal records using physical rules (sensor spikes, negative or incoherent temperature rises, out-of-range set-points) combined with a Random Forest classifier trained on engineer labels. A separate Random Forest, trained only on Valid historical records, predicts the Reference Parameter from voltage, current, temperature, duration and sensors, distinguishing genuine regime shifts from faults.
